title: Configuring a Decoy Connector Management Network

blocks.text: After you configure a Decoy Connector on any supported hypervisor, you need to configure its management network.

blocks.item: Start the Decoy Connector on your hypervisor.
After you are redirected to the Zscaler Deception Recovery Console, enter the username and password. The default username and password is recovery.

After you connect a Decoy Connector to the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal, its recovery password is randomized. You can obtain the new recovery password credentials from the Deception Admin Portal. The username is always recovery.
In the recovery console main menu, enter 2 to configure the management network for the Decoy Connector.
Only one DNS server is allowed.
Select a management interface from the list. For example, enter em0 for VMware platforms.
After the configuration is saved, press Enter to return to the recovery console's main menu.
